label: FP
reason: Alert 1 (xss): alert-FP. Resolved sink value: param = user input stored ONLY as cache key. No HTML/output sink reached. XSS requires user input to be reflected into HTML/response output without encoding. Storing user input as a cache key is not an XSS vulnerability—it does not affect what renders to the browser. The cache.put() call does not write to response or HTML output.

evidence.note: param from request.getParameter flows to cache.put() as key only; no HTML/response output sink involved
